The complete call chain from frontend mutation hook to SQL INSERT is now mapped out.

The frontend hook is `useCreateMemo()` in `/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`. It calls `memoServiceClient.createMemo()`, which is created in `/bench/repo/web/src/connect.ts` via `createClient(MemoService, transport)`. The RPC is defined in `/bench/repo/proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` as `rpc CreateMemo(CreateMemoRequest) returns (Memo)` at POST `/api/v1/memos`.

The TypeScript client stub is generated at `/bench/repo/web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`. The Go Connect adapter is generated at `/bench/repo/proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go` as `/memos.api.v1.MemoService/CreateMemo`.

The handler layer splits into two files. The Connect adapter is `ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo` in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`. The business handler is `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`.

The business logic handler is `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`. The Connect wrapper is a thin transport adapter. The canonical handler with create logic is the APIV1Service method.

The store layer is `/bench/repo/store/memo.go`, where `Store.CreateMemo` delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo`. The SQLite dialect driver is `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go`, which executes the `INSERT INTO memo` statement.

The production UI actually routes memo creation through `useMemoSave` and `memoService.save` in `memoService.ts`, not through the `useCreateMemo` hook. A gRPC-gateway path could also handle HTTP POST directly to `APIV1Service.CreateMemo`, but the web client uses the Connect protocol.
